notes: Large: 3.0 GB of weights plus PyTorch 2.6. Only the files Turbo loads are downloaded (not the original model's 1 GB s3gen.safetensors). One built-in voice; no voice cloning. No speed control. On Linux x86_64, PyTorch brings NVIDIA CUDA libraries (~3 GB download); macOS needs ~0.3 GB.
title: Chatterbox Turbo (English)
